submittedParameters.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Production game sprite 04 mountain guardian boy, one standalone square transparent RGBA frame at least1024. Image1 is the EDIT TARGET: preserve its whole-canvas layout, head and torso size/position, brown hair/green ribbons, gold-green armor/ivory pants, arms/hands and their exact grasp (anatomical right hand long gold staff, left forearm round shield), staff entire shaft/end, jade ring transparent hole. Image2 is SAME-DIRECTION GROUNDED STANCE geometry reference only, do not copy its whole pose. Image3 identity, image4 directional idle/camera, image5 approved painterly style. Redraw only specified lower limb anatomy and clothing folds into a fresh independent motion pose. No mirroring, tweening, collage, repeated image, whole character translation, camera change, ground/shadow/text/effects. Legs must have natural knee flex and weight, knee-ankle-toe aligned in direction of movement, no ankle rolling or sideways duck-foot.  Direction SW frame 6/16. CRITICAL lower-leg correction: preserve SCREEN-RIGHT raised forward boot and knee exactly as in image1; ONLY redraw SCREEN-LEFT bent-back leg downward into continued support. Image2 shows the correct arrangement: small SCREEN-LEFT planted support boot, large SCREEN-RIGHT forward airborne boot. Do NOT reverse those legs. Make screen-left sole carry weight at the position shown by image2, approximately 44% canvas width and 87% canvas height, heel-to-toe axis down-left, foot compactly under/just behind the left-visible hip. This is last full-sole support: modest knee bend, broad sole level contacting ground, close to preceding frame. Retain image1 arms, staff, face, shield, layout. One independent pose.
